record: Sprint 07 owner decisions overlay (execution/design) and licensing record

decisions.OWN-DEC-024 target matrix: Windows x86_64 required personal-use deployment; VST3 stereo effect + Standalone with the same processor; primary DAW FL Studio (owner's installed version, to be recorded), secondary advisory Cubase/Nuendo only if actually available; Linux approved development/testing platform; macOS/AU/AAX/CLAP/mobile/other architectures deferred; stereo-in/stereo-out only; no sampler pads, sequencing, MIDI instruments, sidechains, multichannel
decisions.OWN-DEC-025 framework and dependencies: JUCE for wrapper/UI/standalone; native core stays framework-independent and builds without JUCE; exact pinned release (plugin/JUCE_PIN.json); licensing not waived; no purchase, no publication, no relicensing, no paid terms accepted; approved local dependency checkout permitted
decisions.OWN-DEC-026 product identity: display name SML SP-3000; new stable identity (plugin/product_identity.json); nothing reused from SPZERO / SML SP-06; native schema v1 preserved; identifiers recorded before fixtures; no renaming afterwards
decisions.OWN-DEC-027 clock anchor: KEEP the Sprint 6 sampling-phase anchor unchanged for this first build (acceptance of software behaviour for integration, not a hardware or host-rate-invariance claim); tracked design issue docs/design_issues/DI-001_clock_anchor.md; reference and native anchor unchanged; goldens not regenerated; phase-sensitive checks retained; no cross-rate bit identity claimed; no inaudibility assertion
decisions.OWN-DEC-028 DSP preservation: float64 core, 8x proxy, kernels, quantizer rules/ties, clamps, route defaults, SP→MPC cascade, interstage semantics, state/reset, 10 ms smoothing, latency, research/product separation all preserved; no saturation/noise/EQ/jitter/normalization/limiting/wet-dry/drive/new routes; no SPZERO code; floating-point policy as Sprint 6; portability-only core changes with proof; sonic change needs owner review
decisions.OWN-DEC-029 host audio adapter: stereo I/O; six rates; zero-length/variable/large blocks; prepare/reprepare/reset/suspend/resume/offline; editor before prepare; no extra rate conversion; float32 hosts promoted to float64 with preallocated buffers; float64 where permitted; float32 equivalence oracle uses the same promoted input and the same final cast; G-08 limits and discrete tests preserved
decisions.OWN-DEC-030 bypass: one host-facing plugin_bypass (default false) = latency-aligned original input before all product gains and machine processing; no output trim on the bypassed signal; 10 ms linear crossfade with complementary weights; core and dry delay keep advancing while bypassed; no reset on toggle; rapid toggles continue from the current position; host bypass and editor bypass share one mechanism (no double bypass); host suspension documented separately
decisions.OWN-DEC-031 parameters/automation: only the six frozen controls with existing identifiers; normalized mapping linear in dB, enum order preserved, explicit boolean endpoints; no wrapper smoothing, no 0.1 dB quantization; automation timing per the actual JUCE/VST3 path (block-boundary delivery documented if sample offsets are unavailable); no forked JUCE, no invented timestamps
decisions.OWN-DEC-032 state/presets: host state ↔ native schema v1; only product values + model identity; research/coefficients/calibration/unpopulated routes/reverse order never in presets; INIT recall; no factory bank; parse/validate off the audio thread; bounded RT-safe handoff; no locking copy in process(); no reset on ordinary parameter updates; documented reset policy
decisions.OWN-DEC-033 UI / G-10: original readable SML interface showing SP INPUT → SP ENGINE → INTERSTAGE → MPC ENGINE → OUTPUT; six controls with exact units; meters (input peak, interstage/MPC-input peak where available, output peak, SP/MPC clamp indication, fault status, latency, model/status); unavailable meters display unavailable; no LUFS/RMS/true-peak claims; over-range indicator never clamps; accessibility/tooltips/resizable with limits; no fake animation; no copied panels/logos; prototype authorized, final owner visual/musical approval NOT EXECUTED; screenshots + checklist, no owner preference scored
decisions.OWN-DEC-034 standalone: same processor; device selection if required; no automatic live mic→speaker path (explicit activation); routing safety is not DSP
decisions.OWN-DEC-035 real-time/numerical safety: Sprint 6 policy kept; adapter+core tested for allocations/locks/I/O, NaN/Inf, over-range, silence, thread-safe meters, rapid automation, state handoff, multiple instances, lifecycle; no UI/serialization on the audio thread; no default denormal guard without analysis; sanitizers on the dev build; performance measured with wrapper/conversion/bypass/metering; all timing trials retained
decisions.OWN-DEC-036 validation: inherited tests + VAL-023..026; pluginval strictness 8 with version/command/exit/log recorded; pluginval does not replace FL Studio checks or owner review; no weakening of goldens/thresholds/discrete semantics
decisions.OWN-DEC-037 platform and checkpoints: Windows required; Linux work: independent implementation + Linux validation + exact Windows procedure, Windows/DAW rows NOT RUN/BLOCKED; no fabricated Windows evidence; no artifact-upload dependence; no macOS; clearly labelled implementation/review checkpoint when mandatory Windows/G-10 evidence is unavailable (not PASS)
decisions.OWN-DEC-038 Windows handoff: concise handoff with exact commit, VS/MSVC/CMake components, dependency/licence prerequisites, clean Release commands, test/pluginval commands, artifact locations, identity, DAW checklist; distinguishing source prepared / Windows build performed / artifact produced / plugin validated / plugin installed; no installer, no SPZERO reuse

constraints: do not install anything on the owner's computer
